name: Lovely Lonely Apparition
source:
We are the saviors of a world we no longer remember.

Sterilized pilots of metalbodies that will slay the starry shadows in the corners of humanity’s vision.

But what happens besides that? What do we do? What do we think? What do we love?

Are we allowed to love? Or will we fall between the gaps of each other’s loneliness?

Watch as four pilots on a Federation starship slowly drive each other insane.

A messy novel-type thing about mechpilot slice of life until it all comes crashing down.

[From [url=https://gaybreast.itch.io/lovely-lonely-apparition]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们是一个我们已不记得的世界的救世主。

绝育的金属体飞行员将杀死人类视野角落里的星空阴影。

但除此之外还会发生什么呢？我们该怎么办？我们怎么看？我们爱什么？

我们可以去爱吗？还是我们会陷入彼此孤独的缝隙之中？

观看联邦星舰上的四名飞行员慢慢地将彼此逼疯。

一部关于机甲飞行员生活片段的混乱小说类型的事情，直到一切崩溃。

[来自[url=https://gaybreast.itch.io/lovely-lonely-apparition]itch.io[/url]]
